title: The coast west of the station, and the island under the monorail
caption: The ride used to stay over open sea right up to the platforms. Now, as the train pulls in, the line comes down off the bay, the sea wall and its rocks pass under the car, then lawn with pines, a walk out to a terrace over the rocks, and the platforms. On the island map, the ground west of the platform shed is built: a coast path with a lookout, black pines, the sea wall. Backdrop only (issue #144).

sections.title: Pulling in (desktop)
sections.caption: Before: the start of the arrival, and three seconds in. After: 4, 5, 6 and 7 seconds after the arrival starts (it now runs in at speed for about four seconds before braking).

sections.title: Pulling in (phone)
sections.caption: The phone looks along the car, so the coast comes down the sides.

sections.title: The island map
sections.caption: The forecourt's tile now reaches the coast and covers the platform shed, so there is no sea in the middle of the island. The court's own cameras never see this far, so play frames there are unchanged.

Forecourt from above with its backdrop, after

sections.title: Follow-up: pulling in (desktop)
sections.caption: Issue #160. The arrival was about 12 seconds, the first four over open sea. Now about 8: the sea wall is in frame within the first second, the car eases off over the island so the coast and the lawn pass readably, and the brakes go on along the platforms. Before: 2 and 4 seconds in (still sea). After: 1 to 4 seconds in.

After, 3 s: drifts and pines by the line
After, 4 s: the garden south of the station

sections.title: Follow-up: pulling in (phone)
sections.caption: The same run in on a phone.

sections.title: Follow-up: the coast on the map
sections.caption: The coastline bends now and turns up the beach's west side to meet the seafront's wall. The coast walk is one loop: past the shed, through the lookout on the point, on to a corner terrace where the monorail comes in, then east under the line to a square on the station's axis, where a walk comes down from the station's covered walkway and goes on to the promenade. The lawns have mown bands, beds and drifts, pines in threes along the wall, and a garden south of the station.
